value.rationale: Sharp dimension-uniform one-step Frobenius contraction on a simple rank-two redundant cluster model is a natural test of Gibbs pivoting: it distinguishes balanced exploration from overly concentrated selection and gives a provable critical exponent, with a finite exact strict witness and SPD robustness. This is a structural threshold, not a routine recomputation of a published beta=2 result.
